title: Built Geber, a Chase HQ-inspired arcade game, as a solo dev using Godot + Cursor. First time shipping a 3D game. Would love feedback on the feel and difficulty curve.
author: rekansebangku

comments.author: Megalordow
comments.body: I tried it on itch, good game!

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: Fun! I would suggest adding in more environment and doing some UI would be some easy wins!

replies.author: rekansebangku
replies.body: Thank you! Yeah, still learning about the game engine to polish the visuals, I'll update it regularly. Appreciate the feedback!

comments.author: MessageSelfdestructs
comments.body:
The bare essentials seem to be there, but you can see that refinement is missing:

\- It's too hard to distinguish car from powerup, and it comes up too fast  
\- Steering is sluggish: I know it's meant to be arcade-ish like Chase HQ, but it doesn't feel good yet  
\- It's completely unclear when you've actually reached the car you're meant to smash off the road  
\- Currently driving off the road is just a menial job: it was FUN and challenging to do in Chase HQ, and I'm not feeling the same here

Regardless, impressive how far one can come with only vibe coding.

replies.author: rekansebangku
replies.body:
Fair points all around, especially the ramming feedback, you're right that it's not clear when you're actually in range. That needs a proper cue, not just vibes lol.

Steering and off-road penalty are on my fix list. 

Appreciate you playing it!
